dictionarySource.name: CMU Pronouncing Dictionary, selected words with a small set of local compounds and spelling aliases
dictionarySource.transform: First listed pronunciation; stress marks removed; unstressed AH0 mapped to schwa AX. SHEILD is an alias for SHIELD. Unknown words are spelled. Numbers are read digit by digit.
